Browsers and screen readers ignore an `aria-*` attribute they do not know. A typo such as `aria-labeledby` gives no error anywhere. The element loses its label, and you only find out by testing with a screen reader.

The rule checks every attribute that starts with `aria-`, on elements and on components.

`--fix` corrects five common mistakes: `aria-labeledby`, `aria-lable`, `aria-sorted`, `aria-value` and `aria-role`.

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad {"count": 2} */}
```jsx
const name = <input aria-labeledby="name-label" />;
const menu = <button aria-open={isOpen}>Menu</button>;
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```jsx
const name = <input aria-labelledby="name-label" />;
const menu = <button aria-expanded={isOpen}>Menu</button>;
```
